description: This Java source file defines the DataResourceWorker class, which provides various utility methods for handling content data resources in the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include retrieving, rendering, uploading, and streaming data resources, handling different data resource types such as files, URLs, and binary objects, as well as permissions and MIME type determination.

classes.name: DataResourceWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for handling data resources in the OFBiz framework, including retrieval, rendering, streaming, uploading, permission checks, and MIME type handling.

methods.name: getDataCategoryMap
methods.description: Traverses the DataCategory hierarchy to build a category map with nested children, starting from a parent category ID.

methods.name: getDataCategoryAncestry
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the parent categories for a given DataCategory ID, building a list from top to bottom.

methods.name: buildList
methods.description: Builds an indented list representation of DataCategory nodes, suitable for display in dropdowns.

methods.name: uploadAndStoreImage
methods.description: Handles file upload from an HTTP form, storing image data and updating corresponding data resources.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromImageFileName
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on the image file extension.

methods.name: callDataResourcePermissionCheck
methods.description: Simplifies permission check response as a string status.

methods.name: callDataResourcePermissionCheckResult
methods.description: Performs a detailed permission check for data resources, considering context and external permissions.

methods.name: acquireImage
methods.description: Retrieves binary image data from a DataResource, with cache control.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type of a DataResource, with fallback to defaults or file extension.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Overloaded: Determines MIME type based on filename and default value.

methods.name: getMimeTypeWithByteBuffer
methods.description: Detects MIME type from a ByteBuffer using Apache Tika.

methods.name: buildRequestPrefix
methods.description: Creates a URL prefix based on site and security parameters.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Locates a physical file on server based on dataResourceTypeId and objectInfo.

methods.name: getDataResourceMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type associated with a DataResource.

methods.name: getDataResourceContentUploadPath
methods.description: Generates the directory path for uploading content, considering max files per directory.

methods.name: makeNewDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new subdirectory with timestamp in a parent directory.

methods.name: clearAssociatedRenderCache
methods.description: Clears the Freemarker template cache related to a DataResource.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Renders the content of a DataResource as text, considering templates and mime types.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Overloaded version: renders DataResource as text into Appendable.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Main implementation: renders DataResource as text, with template support and optional web analytics.

methods.name: writeDataResourceText
methods.description: Fetches DataResource content and writes its textual representation to output, handling different resource types.

methods.name: writeText
methods.description: Renders a DataResource's text data with optional MIME templates into output.

methods.name: renderMimeTypeTemplate
methods.description: Renders a MIME type-specific FreeMarker template with provided context.

methods.name: renderFile
methods.description: Reads and outputs the contents of a file based on data resource type.

methods.name: getDataResourceStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream and length for streaming DataResource content, supporting various types including files, URLs, and binary objects.

methods.name: getContentAsByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns a ByteBuffer containing the entire content of a DataResource.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsTextExt
methods.description: Extended version of renderDataResourceAsText, implementing interface method.
